'''Dibrook''' was an uninhabitable [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Albarrio sector/Legends|Albarrio sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
As of [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Dibrook Space Station]] orbited the planet. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], or possibly earlier, the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] established a [[Shaper research facility|base]] on the planet and a [[Yammosk]] was held under the planet's surface. The [[Shaper caste|Shaper]] [[Nagme]] was in charge of this facility.

Following the [[Battle of Dibrook]] in 25 ABY, the ''[[Heart of Artorias]]'' landed on the planet to [[Rescue Mission to Dibrook|search for refugees]] taken by the Yuuzhan Vong during the battle.
